description: Fetch one UK company by an id from search (company:<number>; a bare company number also works). Returns an object with id, title (company name), url (company page on registrum.co.uk), text (a plain-English summary followed by the full enriched profile as JSON: status, type, incorporation date, registered address, SIC codes, accounts and confirmation statement status) and metadata (company_number, company_status, company_type, source). Profile only; use get_bundle, get_psc, get_directors or get_financials for ownership, officers and accounts.
name: fetch
title: Fetch a company
